category_summary: This cycle's research and documentation splits into official capability news, deployment reality-checks, and a busy third-party ecosystem. Leading items: Hermes Agent now supports **[Claude Pro/Max](/?date=2026-11-01&category=research#item-hn-49790991)** subscription authentication via a direct SDK plugin path — a real cost win for Anthropic subscribers — and official docs detail **[Hermes Kanban](/?date=2026-11-01&category=research#item-hn-49604068)**, where multiple agent profiles coordinate on shared work. Two governance signals merit attention: the repository carries roughly [23,000 open PRs](/?date=2026-11-01&category=research#item-hn-49424643), and a GitHub issue asking about Hermes' provenance ([EvoMap's Evolver](/?date=2026-11-01&category=research#item-hn-49208206)) was deleted with the reporter blocked. For operators, deployment coverage is strong: [Revos documents two Kubernetes gaps](/?date=2026-11-01&category=research#item-hn-49977400) (no official **Helm** chart; container image requires root at init), complemented by a [community containerized setup](/?date=2026-11-01&category=research#item-hn-50131496) and an [**Arduino UNO Q**](/?date=2026-11-01&category=research#item-hn-49368474) edge-hosting recipe running on 4GB RAM. On the model-backend side, one user documented [trance-like reasoning loops](/?date=2026-11-01&category=research#item-hn-49916751) on a headless Debian server running **GLM 5.3 Flash** (version not in our model tracker — latest tracked is **GLM 5.2**), the community debated whether Hermes is usable without a routing layer like **[Bifrost](/?date=2026-11-01&category=research#item-hn-49159529)**, and the [hermes-jekyl-hyde](/?date=2026-11-01&category=research#item-hn-49231797) repo probes adversarial behavior of the agent's LLM. Tangential but skimmable: **[EPSBench](/?date=2026-11-01&category=research#item-2610.38293)** (arXiv 2610.38293) benchmarks LLM agents on quarterly EPS forecasting across 86 US firms — useful agent-evaluation context, though not Hermes-specific; a [**Claude Code** earnings-call embeddings plugin](/?date=2026-11-01&category=research#item-hn-49305190) targets a different platform; and the [Hermès trademark thread](/?date=2026-11-01&category=research#item-hn-49357715) is legal chatter with no technical payoff.

items.title: EPSBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Earnings Forecasting
items.content: Quarterly earnings forecasting requires an agent to connect financial evidence to the income-statement line items that produce a company's reported earnings. We introduce EPSBench, a benchmark for studying this ability across 149 firm-quarters from 86 US companies. Agents read a fixed collection of filings, earnings-call transcripts, and news, then estimate company-specific income-statement drivers with cited evidence. A shared accounting calculator converts these estimates into GAAP diluted ear
